Title: Missing file
Use when: A buyer cannot find the download.
Prompt: Draft a reply that asks for the order reference, explains where the library link is, and does not blame the buyer. Do not promise a new file until the order is confirmed.
Check: The reply asks for the reference.

Title: Wrong file
Use when: The buyer expected a different format.
Prompt: Draft a reply that restates the formats listed in the product and offers to check the order. Do not invent a format the product does not have.

Title: Refund request
Prompt: Draft a reply that acknowledges the request and says a person will check the refund policy. Do not approve or refuse the refund.
Check: No refund is granted by the draft.

Title: Angry tone
Prompt: Rewrite my reply so it is short and specific. Remove sarcasm. Keep the decision I already made.

Title: Known issue
Prompt: Draft a reply that states the bug, the workaround I paste below, and that I will write again when it is fixed. Do not give a date I did not provide.

Title: Not our product
Use when: The question is about something else.
Prompt: Draft a reply that says we cannot see that account and points them back to the company they named. Do not guess their password process.
